## Data Preparation: Create Lagged Features

```{r create-lagged-features}
# Sort data by pitcher, at-bat, and pitch number to ensure correct sequence
pitch_data_sorted <- pitch_data_clean %>%
  arrange(player_name, at_bat_number, pitch_number)

# Create lagged features for each at-bat
pitch_data_features <- pitch_data_sorted %>%
  group_by(player_name, at_bat_number) %>%
  mutate(
    # Previous pitch features (lag 1)
    prev_pitch_type_1 = lag(pitch_type, 1),
    prev_zone_1 = lag(zone, 1),
    
    # Previous pitch features (lag 2)
    prev_pitch_type_2 = lag(pitch_type, 2),
    prev_zone_2 = lag(zone, 2),
    
    # Previous pitch features (lag 3)
    prev_pitch_type_3 = lag(pitch_type, 3),
    prev_zone_3 = lag(zone, 3)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Remove first pitch of each at-bat (no previous pitch to predict from)
  filter(!is.na(prev_pitch_type_1)) %>%
  # Convert categorical variables to factors
  mutate(
    pitch_type = as.factor(pitch_type),
    prev_pitch_type_1 = as.factor(prev_pitch_type_1),
    prev_pitch_type_2 = as.factor(prev_pitch_type_2),
    prev_pitch_type_3 = as.factor(prev_pitch_type_3),
    prev_zone_1 = as.factor(prev_zone_1),
    prev_zone_2 = as.factor(prev_zone_2),
    prev_zone_3 = as.factor(prev_zone_3),
    zone = as.factor(zone),
    stand = as.factor(stand),
    balls = as.factor(balls),
    strikes = as.factor(strikes)
  )

# Check the prepared data
head(pitch_data_features)
```

## Evaluate Model Performance

```{r evaluate-models}
# Function to evaluate a pitcher's model
evaluate_pitcher_model <- function(pitcher_name, model, pitcher_data) {
  tryCatch({
    # Make predictions with safe=FALSE to handle missing factor combinations
    predictions <- predict(model, newdata = pitcher_data, type = "class")
    
    # Calculate accuracy - use as.character to avoid factor level issues
    accuracy <- mean(as.character(predictions) == as.character(pitcher_data$pitch_type), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Create confusion matrix - also use as.character
    conf_matrix <- tryCatch({
      pred_char <- as.character(predictions)
      actual_char <- as.character(pitcher_data$pitch_type)
      
      # Get common levels
      common_levels <- sort(unique(c(pred_char, actual_char)))
      
      confusionMatrix(
        factor(pred_char, levels = common_levels),
        factor(actual_char, levels = common_levels)
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      NULL
    })
    
    return(list(
      pitcher = pitcher_name,
      accuracy = accuracy,
      confusion_matrix = conf_matrix,
      error = NULL
    ))
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(list(
      pitcher = pitcher_name,
      accuracy = NA,
      confusion_matrix = NULL,
      error = e$message
    ))
  })
}

# Evaluate all models
model_evaluations <- list()

for (pitcher in names(pitcher_models)) {
  pitcher_data <- pitch_data_features %>%
    filter(player_name == pitcher)
  
  eval <- evaluate_pitcher_model(pitcher, pitcher_models[[pitcher]], pitcher_data)
  model_evaluations[[pitcher]] <- eval
}

# Summary of model accuracies
accuracy_summary <- data.frame(
  pitcher = names(model_evaluations),
  accuracy = sapply(model_evaluations, function(x) x$accuracy),
  error = sapply(model_evaluations, function(x) {
    if (!is.null(x$error)) return(x$error) else return(NA)
  })
) %>%
  arrange(desc(accuracy))

print(accuracy_summary)

# Check how many models had errors
cat("\n\nModels with errors:", sum(!is.na(accuracy_summary$error)), "\n")
cat("Models successful:", sum(is.na(accuracy_summary$error) & !is.na(accuracy_summary$accuracy)), "\n")

# Show some example errors
if (sum(!is.na(accuracy_summary$error)) > 0) {
  cat("\n\nExample errors:\n")
  error_examples <- accuracy_summary %>%
    filter(!is.na(error)) %>%
    head(5)
  print(error_examples)
}
```

## Example: Detailed Results for One Pitcher

```{r example-pitcher}
# Select the first pitcher with a model
example_pitcher <- names(pitcher_models)[1]

cat("Detailed results for:", example_pitcher, "\n\n")

# Show model summary
cat("Model Coefficients:\n")
summary(pitcher_models[[example_pitcher]])

# Show confusion matrix
cat("\n\nConfusion Matrix:\n")
print(model_evaluations[[example_pitcher]]$confusion_matrix)

# Get predictions with probabilities
example_data <- pitch_data_features %>%
  filter(player_name == example_pitcher)

predicted_probs <- predict(pitcher_models[[example_pitcher]], 
                           newdata = example_data, 
                           type = "probs")

# Show first few predictions with probabilities
cat("\n\nExample Predictions (first 5 pitches):\n")
results_df <- cbind(
  example_data[1:5, c("prev_pitch_type_1", "prev_zone_1", "balls", "strikes", "pitch_type")],
  predicted_probs[1:5, ]
)
print(results_df)
```

## Predict Next Pitch for New Sequence

```{r predict-function}
# Function to predict next pitch given previous sequence
predict_next_pitch <- function(pitcher_name, prev_pitch_1, prev_zone_1, 
                                prev_pitch_2 = NA, prev_zone_2 = NA,
                                balls, strikes, stand) {
  
  if (!pitcher_name %in% names(pitcher_models)) {
    return("No model available for this pitcher")
  }
  
  # Create new data frame for prediction
  new_data <- data.frame(
    prev_pitch_type_1 = factor(prev_pitch_1, levels = levels(pitch_data_features$prev_pitch_type_1)),
    prev_zone_1 = factor(prev_zone_1, levels = levels(pitch_data_features$prev_zone_1)),
    prev_pitch_type_2 = factor(prev_pitch_2, levels = levels(pitch_data_features$prev_pitch_type_2)),
    prev_zone_2 = factor(prev_zone_2, levels = levels(pitch_data_features$prev_zone_2)),
    balls = factor(balls, levels = levels(pitch_data_features$balls)),
    strikes = factor(strikes, levels = levels(pitch_data_features$strikes)),
    stand = factor(stand, levels = levels(pitch_data_features$stand))
  )
  
  # Get predictions
  predicted_class <- predict(pitcher_models[[pitcher_name]], newdata = new_data, type = "class")
  predicted_probs <- predict(pitcher_models[[pitcher_name]], newdata = new_data, type = "probs")
  
  # Return results
  return(list(
    predicted_pitch = as.character(predicted_class),
    probabilities = predicted_probs
  ))
}

# Example prediction
example_prediction <- predict_next_pitch(
  pitcher_name = example_pitcher,
  prev_pitch_1 = "FF",  # Previous pitch was a fastball
  prev_zone_1 = "2",    # In zone 2
  prev_pitch_2 = "CH",  # Two pitches ago was a changeup
  prev_zone_2 = "8",    # In zone 8
  balls = 1,
  strikes = 1,
  stand = "R"           # Right-handed batter
)

cat("\n\nExample Prediction:\n")
cat("Predicted next pitch:", example_prediction$predicted_pitch, "\n")
cat("Probabilities:\n")
print(example_prediction$probabilities)
```

## Visualize Results

```{r visualizations}
# Plot accuracy distribution
ggplot(accuracy_summary, aes(x = reorder(pitcher, accuracy), y = accuracy)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Model Accuracy by Pitcher",
       x = "Pitcher",
       y = "Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(accuracy_summary$accuracy), 
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = mean(accuracy_summary$accuracy) + 0.02,
           label = paste0("Mean: ", round(mean(accuracy_summary$accuracy), 3)),
           color = "red")

# Compare to baseline (most common pitch)
baseline_accuracy <- pitch_data_features %>%
  group_by(player_name) %>%
  summarise(
    most_common_pitch = names(which.max(table(pitch_type))),
    baseline_accuracy = max(table(pitch_type)) / n()
  )

comparison <- accuracy_summary %>%
  left_join(baseline_accuracy, by = c("pitcher" = "player_name")) %>%
  mutate(improvement = accuracy - baseline_accuracy)

ggplot(comparison, aes(x = baseline_accuracy, y = accuracy)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Model Accuracy vs. Baseline (Most Common Pitch)",
       x = "Baseline Accuracy",
       y = "Model Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Load saved model objects
pitcher_models     <- readRDS("pitcher_models_basic.rds")
pitch_data_features <- readRDS("pitch_data_features_basic.rds")
model_evaluations  <- readRDS("model_evaluations_basic.rds")
```

```{r}
# --- Baseline accuracy: accuracy if you always predict the most common pitch ---
baseline_accuracy <- pitch_data_features %>%
  group_by(player_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pitches       = n(),
    most_common_pitch   = names(which.max(table(pitch_type))),
    baseline_accuracy = max(table(pitch_type)) / n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_pitches >= 500)  # 500-pitch threshold

# --- Pull model accuracies from evaluations ---
model_accuracy <- data.frame(
  player_name = names(model_evaluations),
  model_accuracy = sapply(model_evaluations, function(x) x$accuracy),
  row.names = NULL
)

# --- Join and compute improvement ---
improvement_summary <- baseline_accuracy %>%
  inner_join(model_accuracy, by = "player_name") %>%
  mutate(improvement = model_accuracy - baseline_accuracy,
       relative_lift = improvement / baseline_accuracy) %>%
  arrange(desc(improvement))

# --- Print ranked list ---
cat("Pitchers (500+ pitches) ranked by predictive improvement over baseline:\n\n")

improvement_summary %>%
  select(player_name, n_pitches, most_common_pitch,
         baseline_accuracy, model_accuracy, improvement, relative_lift) %>%
  mutate(across(c(baseline_accuracy, model_accuracy, improvement), ~ round(.x, 4))) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```
